# Salesforce Login Troubleshooting

## Verify the sign-in page

Open Salesforce using the company-approved bookmark or fictional People
Portal. Do not use a sign-in link from an unexpected email or chat message.
If the approved portal is unavailable, contact the fictional IT Service Desk.

## Password rejected

Confirm that the correct Northstar Works training account is selected. Use
only the company-approved password reset process. Never send a password or
verification code to support staff.

## Multi-factor authentication issue

Use the configured company authenticator for the expected sign-in request.
Never share a verification code with support staff. If the expected prompt
does not appear, contact the fictional IT Service Desk; do not bypass
multi-factor authentication.

## Account appears locked

Stop repeated sign-in attempts if the account is reported as locked. Record
the exact displayed error without including a password or code. Contact the
fictional IT Service Desk to review the account lock. This guide cannot access
or unlock an account.

## Browser or other sign-in error

Confirm that the browser is using the company-approved sign-in page and that
the account name is entered correctly. If sign-in still fails, contact the
fictional IT Service Desk and include the displayed error text without
passwords, verification codes, or session tokens.

This procedure is synthetic and does not describe a real Salesforce tenant.
